clue.text: Jazz standard in Maine?

definitions.meaning: a much-recorded 1931 popular song, sung by Billie Holiday and many others
the US state of Maine is abbreviated ME, so the entire abbreviation is the state; the question mark flags the whimsy

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is the title of a famous jazz song and also a jokey description of the postal code for Maine taken whole.

clue.text: Make amends when catching cold right now

indicators.note: one word catching another means holding it inside, so the cold letter goes into the amends word

parts.note: to make amends is to atone
C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone told to apologise immediately while they have a cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean immediately, without any delay.

clue.text: Asian city learning about a hospital

indicators.note: the learning word goes round the other pieces, as about can mean surrounding

parts.note: lore is traditional learning or knowledge
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A city in Asia where education centres on a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Lahore is a major city in Pakistan, capital of Punjab province.

clue.text: Old squares getting money back to introduce variety

parts.note: fora is the Latin plural of forum, an ancient Roman public square
change is the money handed back after paying

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned people receive a refund, which spices things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squares' tempts you towards fuddy-duddies, but these are Roman market squares.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something for a change means doing it for the sake of variety.

clue.text: Run over

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a run not scored off the bat, such as a bye or a wide, is added to the total as a bonus

explanation.definitionFit: Cricket counts byes and wides as extras, and anything surplus is extra.

clue.text: Get tight and make a mess

definitions.meaning: to tighten by turning a screw, fastening firmly

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to fasten with screws until tight and, informally, to bungle.

clue.text: Extremely short service no good for writer

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters
the good letter is to be absent from the church service word

parts.note: evensong is an evening church service

explanation.surface: A writer complains about a brief and poor church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely short' gives ST, the two ends of 'short'.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Louis Stevenson was the Scottish author of Treasure Island.

clue.text: Home shortly, with time to relax

parts.note: res is a short form of residence, a home

explanation.surface: Being home soon, with time to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: To rest is to relax and take a break from activity.

clue.text: Cautious about imprudent words in guarantee

indicators.note: the cautious word goes about, surrounding, the words piece

parts.note: wary means cautious
a rant is an intemperate outpouring of words

explanation.surface: Wary of rash promises written into a guarantee.
explanation.definitionFit: A warranty is a written guarantee covering repair or replacement.

clue.text: Man dropped from show, necessarily

indicators.note: the man word is removed from the show word

parts.note: a performance is a show

explanation.surface: A man is axed from a show because he had to be.
explanation.definitionFit: Perforce is an old-fashioned word meaning by necessity, unavoidably.

clue.text: Different dam not beginning

indicators.note: the dam word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially livestock

explanation.surface: A different dam is not getting started.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dam' suggests a barrier on a river, but here it is an animal's mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Other means different or distinct from the one already mentioned.

clue.text: Official prize going to first in race

parts.note: to prize something is to treasure it; also a treasure is a prized thing

indicators.note: only the opening letter of race is taken

explanation.surface: An official prize awarded to the race winner.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer is an officer who manages an organisation's funds.

clue.text: Credit for fluid in breakfast food for birds

indicators.note: credit goes in, standing for the fluid abbreviation within the cereal
credit goes in, standing for the fluid abbreviation within the cereal

parts.note: cornflakes are a breakfast cereal
FL is an abbreviation for fluid, as in fl oz
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: Swapping cereal for a credit purchase of liquid.
explanation.definitionFit: Corncrakes are secretive brown birds of the rail family found in meadows.

clue.text: Headlight required by such a lorry?

indicators.note: the light is called for by the words that follow, sitting within them

explanation.surface: A lorry of this type needs a headlamp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Headlight' reads as a vehicle lamp; it is a light round the head, as a saint wears.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is a circle of light shown around a saint's head.

clue.text: Lacking aspiration, they listened to Genesis etc — but that was a long time ago

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: aspiration is the breathed sound of H, so that letter is dropped

parts.note: heard means listened to
Genesis and the following books form the Old Testament, OT

explanation.surface: Fans heard the band Genesis long ago, without ambition.
explanation.walkthrough: Genesis looks like the rock band but is the first book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: The year dot is an informal phrase for a very long time ago, the earliest times.

clue.text: Number three in a cast working right away

indicators.note: the letters of these words are worked into a new arrangement
the right letter is taken away from the reworked pool

explanation.surface: Three actors in a cast working, with one character written out.
explanation.walkthrough: Number is something that numbs, not a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: An anaesthetic is a drug that numbs, so it is a numbing agent.

clue.text: Notice woman with son in difficult circumstances

parts.note: an ad, advertisement, is a notice

indicators.note: the son letter goes into the woman's name

parts.note: Verity is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A notice about a woman and her son in hard times.
explanation.definitionFit: Adversity is hardship and misfortune.

clue.text: Opera is far off — in China?

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go inside the friend word

parts.note: china is Cockney rhyming slang for mate (china plate), so a pal

indicators.note: off signals the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: An opera house is far away, in China perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: China looks like the country but is Cockney rhyming slang: china plate means mate. 'off' is the anagram signal, and the question mark warns that China is not literal.
explanation.definitionFit: Parsifal is Wagner's last opera, about the Grail knight.

clue.text: Using body language to represent lust and rage

indicators.note: the letters are rearranged to represent something new

explanation.surface: Acting out lust and rage through movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Gestural describes communicating through gestures and bodily movements.

clue.text: Nye Bevan's new program regularly introduced in town

indicators.note: the picked letters are introduced into the rearranged name
new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

indicators.note: every other letter of program is taken

explanation.surface: Welsh politician Nye Bevan's new scheme comes into a town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes RGA from pRoGrAm, which is introduced into ABEVENNY (Nye Bevan rearranged). Nye Bevan was a Welsh Labour politician; Abergavenny is in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Abergavenny is a market town in Monmouthshire, south Wales.

clue.text: Ray Reardon? Primarily a sportsman

parts.note: a skate is a kind of ray, a flat fish

indicators.note: only the opening letter of Reardon is taken

explanation.surface: Ray Reardon was mainly a sportsman.
explanation.walkthrough: Ray Reardon was a Welsh snooker champion, so the name looks whole; it splits into the fish and an initial.
explanation.definitionFit: A skater is a sportsman who skates, on ice or in skateboarding.

clue.text: Monstrous creature has kept dark flower

parts.note: an orc is a monster of fantasy fiction
to keep something dark is to hide it

explanation.surface: A monster has hidden a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchid is an exotic flowering plant.

clue.text: Block Brock's retreat

definitions.meaning: Brock is the traditional name for a badger, whose burrow has a particular name

explanation.definitionFit: Sett names both a granite paving block and a badger's den.

clue.text: Promoter keeping odd part for young celebrity

indicators.note: the promoter word holds the other piece inside

parts.note: a backer is someone who promotes or supports a venture

indicators.note: odd signals the letters are in a strange order

explanation.surface: A promoter holds on to a strange role for a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' reads as describing an unusual role, but it signals the anagram; 'keeping' puts that jumble inside. Brat Pack was the 1980s label for a set of young Hollywood actors.
explanation.definitionFit: A Brat Pack was a group of young celebrities; a member is one young star.

clue.text: Crack shot disheartened in meeting

parts.note: to have a crack is to try

indicators.note: the heart, middle letter, of shot is removed, leaving its ends

explanation.surface: A gunman is dejected at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A tryst is a secret meeting, usually romantic.

clue.text: People in America raised a starchy tuber

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means turned upwards, read backwards

parts.note: a yam is a starchy tuber

explanation.surface: Americans grow a starchy root.
explanation.definitionFit: The Maya are an indigenous people of Central America.

clue.text: Representing country, attempt to ignore right protocol

parts.note: for means on behalf of, representing
Mali is a country in West Africa

indicators.note: the right letter is ignored, left out of the attempt word

parts.note: a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Playing for one's country, a try is disallowed for right protocol.
explanation.definitionFit: Formality is strict observance of protocol and convention.

clue.text: Throw away 500 yen

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
a yen is a longing, an itch

explanation.surface: Discard 500 Japanese currency units.
explanation.definitionFit: To ditch something is to discard or get rid of it.

clue.text: Composing music?

parts.note: composing read as calming someone down, not writing notes: music that soothes a child to sleep

explanation.definitionFit: A lullaby is a soft song sung to calm a baby to sleep.

clue.text: Oddly enough, trust your head to have worked as a teacher

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: Strangely, trusting your instinct proved instructive.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutored means taught or coached someone privately.
